# Material Color Utilities

Pure Java color utilities from Google Material Components Android 1.13.0, pinned to
`84c0e6d6d493fcf176d2099683245b78afbeb78d`. Used for the native implementation of the full product palette.

`SOURCES.json` records immutable source URLs, original/adapted SHA256 and the minimal adaptations. Algorithms and original
license headers are preserved; the package is relocated and source-only Error Prone annotations are removed.
The Android app adds this source directory explicitly. No full Material Views library or runtime resources are bundled.

Original notices are retained under the [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE). Update source pins and manifest hashes together;
do not place first-party business code in this directory. Workspace checks verify the complete source closure.
